{{Top|leg}}
'''Spacers Leather''' was form of an incredibly tough form of leather.

Spacers leather was a extremely strong leather, and used a hide that was both thin and flexible, yet at the same time so strong and versatile as to be comparable to [[Blast vest/Legends|semi-armor]]. Spacers leather was even strong enough to resist vacuum, and was used for such a purpose in a jump suit worn by [[Mako Spince]].
